info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Wroewolf Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Wroewolf Notebook Details API facilitates the creation of detailed entries in the catalog for Wroewolf notebooks. This allows users to define various attributes and specifications associated with each notebook, ensuring a comprehensive product representation. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that require accurate cataloging of notebook products. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their product offerings and improve customer experiences through detailed information.

post.summary: Create a new Wroewolf notebook detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new detail for a Wroewolf notebook. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully create a notebook detail record.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating or updating details of a Wroewolf notebook. It should contain all necessary fields that define the notebook's attributes.

200.description: Request completed successfully and details returned.

CreateCatalogWroewolfNotebookDetailReque.title: Wroewolf Notebook Details Request Body

wroewolf_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier for the Wroewolf notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name of the individual requesting the notebook.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the notebook.

CreateCatalogWroewolfNotebookDetailReque.description: Schema representing the request body for creating or updating Wroewolf notebook details.

CreateCatalogWroewolfNotebookDetailRespo.description: Response schema for the successful operation of creating or updating a notebook. Contains the status, record identifier, processing time, and matched count.
